answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, reset on any identity-link attempt, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. What survives to the copper is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The violet is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the wharf. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short.
